LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgNoBrakes: The {VEHICLE} has no brakes left. It will still drive, but it cannot stop where you tell it: it runs on, and strikes whatever is in its way. A mechanic should see to the brakes first.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_OverrunStart: The {VEHICLE} cannot stop. It is running on.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_OverrunStruck: The {VEHICLE}, with no brakes, ran on and struck {THING}.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_KeepNoBrakes: the {VEHICLE} has no brakes; nobody takes it out for work until a mechanic has seen to them
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_KeepClutchGone: the {VEHICLE}'s clutch is worn through; nobody takes it out for work until a mechanic has fitted a new one
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_GravshipOverhang: Warning: these vehicles stand partly off the ship's floor. They will come along, with part of each hanging over the edge:
